cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: curry in bread rolls, no plates. Slice horizontally, please; we need a base, not a sandwich slit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have six rolls and twelve guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then both halves become dishes. Equal depth, please. Twice the service from the same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off the flat halves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better still: hollow them, leaving the crust intact. Stir the crumbs into the curry. Containers and thickener from one cut; hand me the knife and watch the edge.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 horizontal cutting, A3 equal halves and A5 intact-crust hollowing make cooking expertise invent savings from every setback.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 six for twelve causes A3 both halves; B4 runoff causes A5 bowls and crumbs used as thickener.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 identify real supply and shape problems that A method adapts to.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns the material removed to solve B4 runoff into another saving.
